limitations: 20 named broker searches are attempts, not 20 inspected accounts. Search repeatedly returned irrelevant results even for exact queries; no claim of complete Instagram coverage.
The current WhatsApp reader samples the first 200 chat entries and selects at most 45 histories. Not every saved source or account chat is covered.

250 Status records were screened by available text/caption/metadata. Only three low-resolution image previews were viewed; full images, PDF documents and videos were not reviewed. An image record alone is not content coverage.
Instagram Stories remain inaccessible. Indexed YouTube searches were attempted, but no relevant new launch video was fully watched.
Aldar newsroom rendered zero items in the retrieved shell; not evidence that no announcements exist.
